content.title: Benchmark’s (NYSE:BHE) Q3: Beats On Revenue
content.summary: Electronics manufacturing services provider Benchmark (NYSE:BHE) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 3.5% year on year to $680.7 million.
